scope: Lean 4 model of the RuntimeProof private-supertrait seal plus Rust-side model/code consistency check.
model_assumptions: The model covers the private-supertrait sealed-trait rule, not full Rust semantics.
A downstream crate can name public traits but cannot name private traits owned by frankenterm-core.
A RuntimeProof implementation requires both the public trait and the private sealed supertrait.
The declared implementation list is cross-checked against crates/frankenterm-core/src/runtime_proof.rs.

rust_consistency_check.assertion: Lean declared implementation names equal live Rust RuntimeProof impl names, and every RuntimeProof impl has a matching sealed::Sealed impl.

validation.result: Lean proof checked and theorem inventory verified
